alex_sre: FYI after last night's RBAC tighten we're seeing mTLS handshake errors in ap-south and eu-west. Proxy logs show KMS decrypt denies for the ephemeral-rotator SA.

mira_sec: paste a sample error?

alex_sre: `tls: failed to configure private key: kms:DecryptAccessDenied: principal serviceAccount:ephemeral-rotator@prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com missing roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`

leo_platform: that SA lost decrypt in PR #3580. I can revert but want audit first.

oncall_bot: alert: 5xx rate up 2.3% in async-routing for 11:08-11:14 UTC.

mira_sec: get CloudAudit logs and IAM diff. Check if a delegated token was revoked.

alex_sre: query found ~95 Deny events in ap-south1 and 7 in eu-west1 during the window.

leo_platform: rolling back PR 3580 now and adding temporary exception for rotator SA with TTL 45m. Will annotate details in the PR.

oncall_bot: rollback merged by leo_platform at 2026-03-23T11:20:12Z

alex_sre: handshake errors dropped within 90s. Suggest: add proxy fallback to use cached key for 15s on unwrap failure.

mira_sec: agree. Also add alert: KMS DecryptAccessDenied > 5 in 5m -> page. Export audit logs to incident folder for postmortem.

leo_platform: post-incident tasks: repro in staging, create least-privileged KMS role with IAM Conditions (restrict by SA and key name), ensure consistent bindings across projects/regions, and update runbook.

alex_sre: thanks 44D please post audit export link here when ready.
